changelog.entry: Slingshot is here, as a working title. Plan a probe's burns on a quiet chart (when, which way, how hard), see the whole flight appear as soon as the plan changes, drag the time slider to look at any moment, and press Fly to make it count. Chapter 1 has seven missions to the Moon from a high Earth orbit; Chapter 2 has Mars on its real dates, then Phobos and Deimos; Chapter 3 uses Venus's pull to reach the Sun's neighbourhood on less fuel. A Moon Atlas collects every place you reach, with a card of real numbers. Nothing is timed and a miss is only a report.
